name: Sieve Buddy
summary: Sefrek imzizdigen Sieve i Proton Mail d yal aqeddac ManageSieve neɣ JMAP seg Thunderbird s timmad-is: amaẓrag i yessnen aqeddac-ik, amsalel i d-yettwaskanen anda ara tekcem tabrat, d yilugan seg tabrat s sin n yiflak kan.
description:
Ẓreg imzizdigen n yimayl-ik war ma teqqneḍ ɣer webmail yal tikkelt. Sieve Buddy iteddu d Proton Mail yerna, s tmellit Docker yettwafernen, d yal aqeddac ManageSieve (Dovecot, Stalwart, Cyrus, Mailcow, mailbox.org d wiyaḍ) d JMAP for Sieve. Timahilin
  • Amaẓrag i yessnen tutlayt n uqeddac: beṭṭu n tseddast s yiwenniten, isumar i yiwenden, i yixef n tebratin d yiwuliren-ik, asenqed s tuffɣa n require i yettwattun, n tebrinin d yiwuliren arussinen, tallalt mi ara tesɛiḍ taɣerdayt, taɣessa d umsakal.
  • Alugen Sieve seg tebratt: sit s uzelmaḍ ayeffus ɣef tabratt neɣ seqdec taqeffalt deg tmuɣli n tebratt. Sieve Buddy isumer tiwtilin, yufa amkan akk ufrin deg usekript-ik yerna isɛeddi tuccaḍ i yellan ma yezmer.
  • Tabrat n uɛeggel: amsalel yesskan anda ara tkcem tabrat send ad teskelseḍ.
  • Amyellel n yilugan: 16 n yinuzen i yismawen n taɣult, tebdarin n tebratin, tfakturin, tiḥanutin, tiririt tawurmant ma ur telliḍ ara d wayen-nniḍen.
  • Ixfawen: sleḍ asekript meqqren s yizwal, beddel neɣ kkes ilugan s yiwen n uxef.
  • Asekles aɣelsan: diff send yal asekles d umazray n yileqman yezrin.
Proton Mail Proton ur yesɛi ara API unṣib i yimzizdigen. Sieve Buddy yesseqdac API web yebnan am umsaɣ web n Proton, yerna Proton izmer ad t-ibeddel melmi i yebɣa. Awal-ik uffir ur d-yettaffeɣ ara seg Thunderbird d aḍris amraw (SRP), kan ajiṭun n tɣimit i yettwaklasen. Asagem yella s teglizit d talmanit. War assaɣ ɣer Proton AG.
